[SWS_DM_01062] Transmission of all
PDIDs
on the periodic connection
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04215
⌈
If the
PDID
transmission is triggered for a requested transmission rate,
the DM shall transmit all
PDIDs
on the periodic transmission by call-
ing
apext::diag::uds_transport::UdsTransportProtocolPeriodicHan-
dler::PeriodicTransmit
on the periodic connection starting with the first
PDID
in the list of scheduled
PDIDs
.
⌋
